levels.name: Member
levels.privilege: Create requests. Hide username from peerlists. Download a .zip file of snatches on their profile

levels.name: Power User
levels.privilege: Immunity to inactivity pruning. Access to PU forums. Access to invite forums. Freeleech access in advanced search. Can send bonus points to other users. Can edit movie group information. Access to on-site notifications. Access to the IRC announce channels. Create collections and edit existing ones

levels.name: Elite
levels.privilege: Access to Elite forums. Can purchase invites from the bonus point store

levels.name: Torrent Master
levels.privilege: Access to TM forums. Receive 2 invites per month

levels.name: Torrent King
levels.privilege: Can create personal collections to feature on their profile. Granted ability to double post in forums. Unlimited search and log results. Immunity from ratio-based demotion

levels.name: Custom Class
levels.privilege: Can chose their own class title. Immunity from ratio-based demotion
